title: Gate CCP2 production conformance in CI
description: Build the joined CCP2 gate across Python/Rust/C production paths after all language integrations. Map CCP2-001..026 to nonzero independent vector consumption, signed wire/mixed-version rejection, real scheduler and radio-event flows, fuzzing and multi-node scenarios. Cover unequal density, sparse/upper-band masks, sender/receiver/RX-TX conflicts, persistent hash collisions, stale epochs/root transitions, exactly-three desync/recovery, ordinary-data-not-beacon, complete frame/setup/guard fit, queue expiry and generation invalidation. Compare true delivery/loss/latency/airtime at equal offered workloads for single versus multiple receivers; zero delivery is failure, not latency improvement. Reuse existing consumers after verifying stale open issues; do not weaken old tests or duplicate production formulas in the oracle.
acceptance_criteria: CI reliably fails each injected contract violation and unknown/empty corpus; all production implementations pass their applicable matrix with recorded commands/revisions. Native/host/fuzz scenarios run on supported toolchains. Three independent reviews for code changes with findings filed and fixed. Result is software conformance only, not hardware or legal approval.
